description: Loxapine inhalation powder (Adasuve) is a typical antipsychotic delivered via a single-use, breath-actuated inhaler. It is indicated for the rapid control of mild-to-moderate agitation in adults with schizophrenia or bipolar I disorder. The inhaled route provides quick onset while minimizing systemic exposure compared to oral or parenteral formulations. Adasuve carries a boxed warning for bronchospasm and is available only through a REMS program.

sections.content: Loxapine inhalation powder (Adasuve) is a typical antipsychotic delivered via a single-use, breath-actuated inhaler. It is indicated for the rapid control of mild-to-moderate agitation in adults with schizophrenia or bipolar I disorder. The inhaled route provides quick onset while minimizing systemic exposure compared to oral or parenteral formulations. Adasuve carries a boxed warning for bronchospasm and is available only through a REMS program.
